profile.headline: Software Engineer at Aurora
profile.summary: Currently a firmware engineer at Zoox. I've had the pleasure of working at many self-driving initiatives and have plentiful experience designing, testing and supporting embedded vehicle and compute systems. I hold great interest in the applications of C++ in embedded systems, hardware acceleration and low-latency computing.
